cases.generated_sql: SELECT `q`.`mktcode`, `q`.`tgtcode`, `q`.`bizdate` FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS q INNER JOIN (SELECT `q`.`mktcode`, `q`.`tgtcode`, AVG(`q`.`volume`) AS `metric_0` FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS q WHERE `q`.`bizdate` IN (SELECT `calendar_sessions`.`bizdate` FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS calendar_sessions GROUP BY `calendar_sessions`.`bizdate` ORDER BY `calendar_sessions`.`bizdate` DESC LIMIT 7) GROUP BY `q`.`mktcode`, `q`.`tgtcode`) AS aggregate_0 ON `q`.`mktcode` = `aggregate_0`.`mktcode` AND `q`.`tgtcode` = `aggregate_0`.`tgtcode` INNER JOIN (SELECT `q`.`mktcode`, `q`.`tgtcode`, MIN(`q`.`volume`) AS `metric_1` FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS q WHERE `q`.`bizdate` IN (SELECT `calendar_sessions`.`bizdate` FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS calendar_sessions GROUP BY `calendar_sessions`.`bizdate` ORDER BY `calendar_sessions`.`bizdate` DESC LIMIT 5) GROUP BY `q`.`mktcode`, `q`.`tgtcode`) AS aggregate_1 ON `q`.`mktcode` = `aggregate_1`.`mktcode` AND `q`.`tgtcode` = `aggregate_1`.`tgtcode` WHERE `q`.`bizdate` = (SELECT MAX(`q_latest`.`bizdate`) FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS q_latest) AND `aggregate_0`.`metric_0` > `aggregate_1`.`metric_1`
cases.reference_sql: WITH a7 AS (SELECT b.mktcode,b.tgtcode,AVG(b.volume) AS volume_avg FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS b WHERE b.bizdate IN ('2026-04-14','2026-04-13','2026-04-10','2026-04-09','2026-04-08','2026-04-07','2026-04-03') GROUP BY b.mktcode,b.tgtcode), m5 AS (SELECT b.mktcode,b.tgtcode,MIN(b.volume) AS volume_min FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS b WHERE b.bizdate IN ('2026-04-14','2026-04-13','2026-04-10','2026-04-09','2026-04-08') GROUP BY b.mktcode,b.tgtcode) SELECT q.mktcode,q.tgtcode,q.bizdate FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS q INNER JOIN a7 ON a7.mktcode=q.mktcode AND a7.tgtcode=q.tgtcode INNER JOIN m5 ON m5.mktcode=q.mktcode AND m5.tgtcode=q.tgtcode WHERE q.bizdate='2026-04-14' AND a7.volume_avg>m5.volume_min
